Admin routes of the shipping module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/shipping/methods

List shipping methods

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).
- `zoneId` in query (string, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Methods retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/shipping/methods

Create shipping method

Request body: [CreateShippingMethodAdminDto](#createshippingmethodadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Method created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## DELETE /v1/admin/shipping/methods/{id}

Delete shipping method

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Method deleted.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Method not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/shipping/methods/{id}

Update shipping method

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdateShippingMethodAdminDto](#updateshippingmethodadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Method updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Method not found.

## GET /v1/admin/shipping/zones

Parameters:

- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

## POST /v1/admin/shipping/zones

## PATCH /v1/admin/shipping/zones/{id}

Update shipping zone

Parameters:

Responses:
